items.html: And we shall explain the division of the name MA. The matter is that it is known that the ten Sefirot of Atzilut divide into five Partzufim. And indeed, the Partzuf of Arich, too, divides into two, which are: Atik and Arich. And it is known that the Taamim are in Keter, the Nekudot in Hochma, the Tagin in Bina, and the letters in the seven lower [Sefirot], as mentioned in the Tikkunim. And this is exactly so in the division of the ten Sefirot, whether of AB, of SAG, of MA, or of BON. However, the ten Sefirot of Atzilut that are made from these unions of MA and BON do not take them in this order.
